title: Learning Object v1
description: A learning object is a governed teaching artifact that references Librarian evidence findings. It defines lesson content, exercises, assessment references, and certification criteria derived from a diagnostic finding. It does NOT create evidence, authority, or seal capability.

id.description: Unique learning object identifier, e.g. LO-EV-GOV-002-001

title.description: Human-readable title for the learning object

finding_code.description: The diagnostic finding code this learning object derives from

evidence_refs.description: Evidence references that support this learning object

confidence.description: Confidence level of the source finding

source.description: Source finding reference. Links the learning object to governed evidence. The learning object references evidence; it does not become evidence.

title.description: Optional lesson title (defaults to parent title)

objective.description: What the learner will understand after completing this object

explanation.description: Teaching content — explains the finding in educational context. Must be distinct from the raw finding text, adding teaching-specific context, analogies, and implications.

learning.description: Lesson content — the teaching material derived from the source finding. Contains explanation, objectives, and prerequisites.

scenario_id.description: Reference to a scenario definition (in V1.5 format or future format)

setup.description: Context given to the learner before the exercise begins

expected_observations.description: What the learner should observe or discover during the exercise

exercise.description: Optional exercise — a scenario-based activity that tests the learner's understanding of the finding.

items.description: Reference to quiz question IDs from the question bank (e.g. 'l1-q1', 'l2-q3')

quiz_refs.description: References to existing quiz questions. Quiz content is NOT embedded in the learning object — it is referenced.

scoring_model.description: Which scoring model to use. 'evaluateSubmission' maps to V1.5's scoring.js

assessment.description: Assessment configuration. References quiz questions and scoring model. Does NOT contain quiz content inline.

criteria.description: Certification criteria. These evaluate understanding of the governed system, NOT system correctness. They MUST NOT overlap with Librarian seal authority.

passing_score.description: Percentage required to earn certification for this learning object

certification.description: Certification criteria. Defines what passing means in educational terms. Does NOT confer seal, approval, or production-readiness authority.

metadata.description: Optional metadata about the learning object's generation

advisory_only.description: Learning objects are advisory-only. They do not confer authority.

no_seal_authority.description: Learning objects do not confer seal authority.
